title: Sell-through with safe lookups
objective: Use if_not_found for missing codes and IFERROR for the sell-through division.
instructions: Use the product list in G1:I6. In C2:C6 use XLOOKUP to return the opening stock for the code in column B, and in D2:D6 return the units sold. If a code is not on the list, show the text "Not listed" using the XLOOKUP fourth argument. Fix the list ranges with $ signs. In E2:E6 work out sell-through as units sold divided by opening stock, and use IFERROR so that any error shows the text "n/a".
hints: Columns C and D use XLOOKUP. The code to find is in B2. The code column of the list is G2:G6, the stock column is H2:H6 and the units sold column is I2:I6.
Add "Not listed" as the fourth argument of XLOOKUP, and fix the list with $ signs, for example =XLOOKUP(B2,$G$2:$G$6,$H$2:$H$6,"Not listed").
Sell-through in E2 is units sold divided by opening stock, so D2/C2. Put it inside IFERROR as the first argument.
The second argument of IFERROR is what to show when there is an error: "n/a" in double quotes. Check line 3 (not on the list) and line 4 (zero stock).
